item.title: NASA's Moon orbiter finds a 728-foot crater that wasn't there before
item.description: NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter has revealed a 728-foot-wide crater that formed on the Moon in 2024, the largest newly formed crater ever observed.

item.title: NASA's Roman Space Telescope could last more than twice as long as planned
item.description: NASA's Roman Space Telescope may now have enough fuel for at least 22 years of science, more than double its original 10-year design life.
